root.label: Hegseth says most U.S. troops moved off bases and out of Iranian fire range

events.label: Hegseth says most U.S. troops moved off bases and out of Iranian fire range

slots.name: troops moved percentage
slots.sentence: "As we built up offensive combat power, we moved the vast majority of American troops — over 90% of Americans that were on our bases — what we say off the X, out of the range of Iranian fire," Hegseth told reporters in March.
